# New-ZbxCorrelationCondition

## SYNOPSIS

Builds a correlation condition for the -Filter conditions of New-ZbxCorrelation and Set-ZbxCorrelation.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxCorrelationCondition [-Type] <ZabbixCorrelationConditionType> [-FormulaId <string>] [-Operator <ZabbixConditionOperator>] [-Tag <string>] [-GroupId <ulong>] [-OldTag <string>] [-NewTag <string>] [-Value <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A condition decides which new events an event correlation compares with the problems already open, by tag, tag value or host group. The New-ZbxCorrelationCondition cmdlet writes it as a hashtable keyed by the API's field names, which the -Filter conditions of New-ZbxCorrelation and Set-ZbxCorrelation take as it is, alone or in an array. -Type is positional. Nothing is sent to the server, so the command needs no connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Build a condition and use it in a new correlation

```powershell
$sameScope = New-ZbxCorrelationCondition -Type EventTagPair -OldTag 'scope' -NewTag 'scope'
New-ZbxCorrelation -Name 'Disaster correlation' -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @($sameScope) } -Operation @{ type = 'Old' } |
    Select-Object CorrelationId, Name, Status
```

The builder writes one correlation-filter condition as a hashtable; New-ZbxCorrelation sends it in -Filter. This rule closes the old problem when a new event with the same "scope" tag value arrives (operation Old; New closes the new event instead).

### Example 2: Combine conditions on tags and host group

```powershell
$conditions = @(
    New-ZbxCorrelationCondition -Type NewEventTag -Tag 'resolved'
    New-ZbxCorrelationCondition -Type NewEventHostgroup -Operator Equal -GroupId (Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Web servers').GroupId
    New-ZbxCorrelationCondition -Type NewEventTagValue -Tag 'env' -Operator Equal -Value 'prod'
)
$null = New-ZbxCorrelation -Name 'Close stale web problems' -Filter @{ evaltype = 'And'; conditions = $conditions } -Operation @{ type = 'Old' }, @{ type = 'New' }
(Get-ZbxCorrelation -Name 'Close stale web problems' -SelectFilter).Filter.conditions | Format-Table type, tag, operator, value, groupid
```

NewEventTag checks that the new event has a tag, NewEventHostgroup that it comes from a host group (-GroupId), NewEventTagValue compares a tag's value (-Operator). evaltype 'And' requires all of them.
